goal: Pixels -> playable object proposals -> canonical identities -> actual game metadata and visible state, all server-side and free-compatible

change.algorithm: Infer ordinary frame pitch within repeated rows and separately test textured wide gaps with 2.35–4.1 inferred units, max 33% of screen width; never accept card identity from region geometry or similarity alone
change.execution: Full-catalogue default workflow automatically dispatches or reuses supplementary wide-row ranking and exposes candidate lists in fullcatalog_status_v2
change.protocol: All supplementary output is unverified; no HUD or other fallback accepted as playable cards

limitations: The extra Igloo hypothesis is not an independently verified game identity.
Eleven ranked candidate regions do NOT mean 11/11 card recall or accuracy.
Only one of the older screenshot identities has human ground truth; nine original hypotheses remain unverified.
Not yet independently benchmarked against additional unseen screenshots.
Still no full canonical gameplay metadata/instance-state extraction or verified screenshot upload auth.
next_tasks: Obtain human truth for the tenth previously unverified and newly discovered wide card (the Igloo hypothesis) plus remaining nine original regions.
Independently verify wide-region geometry and avoid HUD/decorative false positives across unseen screenshots.
Calibrate score reliability or use crop-aware geometric verification to separate trust from hypothesis.
Integrate canonical gameplay metadata and visible instance state.
Verify authenticated upload/status API and free-tier cost budget before production promotion.
